contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Count elements between lower and upper inclusively. Count duplicates separately; return a number, not a filtered array.
contract.domain: The array is dense, has at most 32 finite numbers between -100 and 100, and must not be modified. Any returned array must be fresh with independent storage. Bounds are finite between -100 and 100 with lower <= upper.
contract.outputRole: count of accepted elements including duplicates
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
